dedupe_keys.name: drone assisted connectivity discovery in post disaster road networks code and data

description: The authors publish simulation code, OSM extracts, seeds and results for UAV reconnaissance after road disruption. Zenodo supplies a MIT-licensed archive. A single drone explores a seismically disrupted road network, with seven strategies compared by the time needed to confirm or refute connectivity between a source and destination. The study uses two Istanbul district graphs and two airport-to-district relief corridors. This model can test information-gathering priorities in emergency road-restoration simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code bundle. Coverage is the specified Istanbul networks, simulated seismic damage and one-UAV strategies, not observed post-earthquake flight operations. A limitation is that mission effectiveness depends on road-damage assumptions, UAV range and what can actually be observed from air. The associated manuscript is described as submitted, not accepted. The archive was not downloaded or executed, and no timing result was reproduced.
